data.body: Main sweep result (reported by cluster A4, session 3d705fec; not worked by A4): run 44636174645, `sweep (windows)` job 135955149952, main at 8c6c4f29af8, concluded `failure`: 1 failed, 20,311 passed, 873 skipped. Failing test: `tests/unit/test_mcp_opcert_signing_goose.py::test_compose_startup_binding_fails_closed_on_bad_key`, with `Failed: DID NOT RAISE OpcertKeyError`. The test chmods the box key to 0o644 and expects `compose_startup_opcert_binding` to fail closed. This test was never in a deselect file (not in `openssh-key-acl.args` before 8c6c4f29af8). It did not fail in the previous 2 main sweeps: job 135849846469 at a28027d5ec7 and job 135902646205 at 0fec72331c4, both `success`. The commits between 0fec72331c4 and 8c6c4f29af8 are 5e08e77ea17, b848a560e01, 91730dac5c1 and 8c6c4f29af8. Which one changed the outcome has not been bisected.
